comparison.objective: Replace a toilet roll on a spring spindle and refit both spindle ends into sockets.
comparison.physical_skill: Spring compression, one-ended support, constrained steering, socket seating, and roll/tube handling.
comparison.success_condition: New roll is on the spindle, both ends are seated, old tube is in the tray, hands are clear, and the assembly is stable.
comparison.reason: This tests spring-loaded socket fitting and exchange of a roll, not fracture at manufactured notches or millimetre-scale metal-fragment recovery.
